title: Add editable text to your images
summary: Create multiline text boxes with portable fonts, size, color, and opacity controls, then move and resize them on the canvas.

Added: Text boxes with Ubuntu Light and Hack Regular fonts, 6–144 pt sizes, and color/opacity controls.
Multiline text, word wrapping, and clipping to resizable text boxes.
A text-edit dialog with Apply/Cancel and one-step undo for a completed edit. Double-click text to edit it again.
Improved: Text stays editable in saved projects and uses the same renderer for the canvas and PNG export.
Draft text is protected when closing the application and does not let Delete remove the selected object while typing.
Release packages now include the bundled fonts' detailed license notices.

limitations: Windows x64 portable preview; the application is not code-signed.
Text supports two bundled fonts and basic left-to-right layout. Unsupported glyphs show an error; complex-script shaping and installed-font selection are not included.
Text is entered in a dialog. Rich text, inline canvas typing, rotation, and callouts remain planned.
Screen capture and global hotkeys are not included yet. Region capture remains development-only pending native verification.
Editable projects retain original pixels. Share a flattened PNG for redacted content.
